annotation.title_clean: PL n. 477/2024 - Tipifica na lei penal a alteração de fotos, vídeos e som com o uso de sistema de Inteligência Artificial para praticar violência contra a mulher
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 477/2024 - Criminalising the alteration of photos, videos and sound using AI systems to commit violence against women
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Saullo Vianna, União/AM)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill amending the Penal Code to criminalise altering photos, videos or audio using AI or other means to embarrass, humiliate, harass or threaten women in domestic or family contexts, with two to four years' imprisonment and a fine. Software-only deepfake issue; no embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Art. 216-C to the Penal Code criminalising manipulation of photos, videos or sounds via AI to harm women
Penalty of 2 to 4 years' imprisonment plus a fine
Limited to domestic or family context
Justified by rising use of AI for gender-based violence and lack of consent
